en.title: Make room for the reading
en.subtitle: A change in the method becomes part of the next task
observation: Opening evidence interrupts the thread of reading.
choices: Bring the source into the reading place
test: Try the new method in the next task
Can attention continue—and can the reader still correct it?
en.return: Use what happens to change the division again
en.retire: A method can also be retired.
en.description: Opening evidence interrupts a reader’s thread. The person and model rearrange the work: cultivate recognition of changes in meaning, retrieve the source in place, and delegate alignment and versioning. The next task tests attention and the ability to correct; its results can change the division again or retire a method.

zh-CN.title: 为阅读留出空间
zh-CN.subtitle: 让方法的改变进入下一次实际任务
observation: 打开证据时，正在追随的思路被打断。
choices: 辨认意义何时发生变化
在阅读处呈现原始材料
test: 在下一次任务中试用新方法
注意力能否延续？读者是否仍能纠正它？
zh-CN.return: 根据实际发生的情况，再次改变分工
zh-CN.description: 打开证据打断阅读思路。人与模型重新分配工作：培养辨认意义变化的能力，在阅读处调取原始材料，将材料对齐和版本管理交给模型。下一次任务检验注意力与纠正能力；实际结果可以再次改变分工，也可以淘汰方法。
